mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lingxing_fba_fee_compare ( asin, msku, sid, local_sku, developer, country, amazon_fba_fee, amazon_fba_fee_report, fee_currency, dev_fba_fee, diff, diff_rate, recent3m_volume, recent3m_profit, tacos, dev_price, actual_price, price_diff, price_diff_rate, synced_at ) WITH qual_asin AS ( SELECT w.asin, SUM(w.volume) AS vol, SUM(w.amount) AS amt, SUM(w.spend) AS spend FROM lingxing_sku_weekly_performance w INNER JOIN lingxing_product_unified u ON u.asin = w.asin WHERE w.`year_month` IN ('2026-05','2026-06','2026-07') GROUP BY w.asin HAVING SUM(w.volume) > 30 ), qual_profit AS ( SELECT asin, SUM(gross_profit) AS profit FROM lingxing_profit_asin WHERE data_date >= '2026-05-01' AND data_date <= '2026-07-31' GROUP BY asin HAVING SUM(gross_profit) > 0 ), msku_list AS ( SELECT DISTINCT w.asin, w.seller_sku AS msku, w.sid, w.sku AS local_sku, w.marketplace AS country FROM lingxing_sku_weekly_performance w INNER JOIN qual_asin q ON q.asin = w.asin INNER JOIN qual_profit qp ON qp.asin = w.asin WHERE w.`year_month` IN ('2026-05','2026-06','2026-07') AND w.seller_sku IS NOT NULL AND w.seller_sku != '' AND w.sid IS NOT NULL ) SELECT m.asin, m.msku, m.sid, m.local_sku, u.developer, m.country, fee.fba_fee, fee.fba_fee_report, fee.fee_currency, dev.dev_fba_fee, (fee.fba_fee - dev.dev_fba_fee) AS diff, CASE WHEN dev.dev_fba_fee IS NOT NULL AND dev.dev_fba_fee != 0 THEN (fee.fba_fee - dev.dev_fba_fee) / dev.dev_fba_fee END AS diff_rate, q.vol, qp.profit, ROUND(q.spend / NULLIF(q.amt, 0), 6) AS tacos, dev.dev_price, ROUND(q.amt / NULLIF(q.vol, 0), 4) AS actual_price, ROUND(q.amt / NULLIF(q.vol, 0), 4) - dev.dev_price AS price_diff, CASE WHEN dev.dev_price IS NOT NULL AND dev.dev_price != 0 THEN (ROUND(q.amt / NULLIF(q.vol, 0), 4) - dev.dev_price) / dev.dev_price END AS price_diff_rate, NOW() FROM msku_list m LEFT JOIN lingxing_product_unified u ON u.asin = m.asin LEFT JOIN qual_asin q ON q.asin = m.asin LEFT JOIN qual_profit qp ON qp.asin = m.asin LEFT JOIN lingxing_listing_fba_fee fee ON fee.sid = m.sid AND fee.msku = m.msku LEFT JOIN lingxing_developer_fba dev ON dev.sku = u.base_sku AND dev.country = m.country ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sid = VALUES(sid), local_sku = VALUES(local_sku), developer = VALUES(developer), country = VALUES(country), amazon_fba_fee = VALUES(amazon_fba_fee), amazon_fba_fee_report = VALUES(amazon_fba_fee_report), fee_currency = VALUES(fee_currency), dev_fba_fee = VALUES(dev_fba_fee), diff = VALUES(diff), diff_rate = VALUES(diff_rate), recent3m_volume = VALUES(recent3m_volume), recent3m_profit = VALUES(recent3m_profit), tacos = VALUES(tacos), dev_price = VALUES(dev_price), actual_price = VALUES(actual_price), price_diff = VALUES(price_diff), price_diff_rate = VALUES(price_diff_rate), synced_at = VALUES(synced_at)
